bugs_found: loan_payment uses m+1 instead of m, silently under/over-calculating loan payments
transfer is not atomic: debit happens before credit, so an exception during credit can leave balances inconsistent
transfer does not normalize/validate amount type or finiteness, allowing mixed numeric types or NaN-like values to break comparisons/arithmetic
compound_interest and loan_payment silently truncate years/months/compounds_per_year via int(), changing caller intent without validation
compound_interest does not reject negative principal
fx_convert does not validate rate positivity/finite value, allowing negative or invalid FX rates
apply_fee can return a negative net amount when fixed/min fee exceeds amount
